title: 4/12 fallback deadline computed from the primary's game landed 3 minutes after the double-down's first pitch
tier_reason: near miss: the live scheduler planned its fallback post for 13:40, after the double-down's 13:37 first pitch (the submission cutoff), but the operator's hotfix deployed at about 13:10 and the day's pick was delivered at 13:40 with 14:15 as its earliest game

contract.text: An unlocked pick is fallback-posted before the earliest first pitch among its legs (the BTS submission cutoff).

mechanism.text: both fallback-deadline sites computed primary_pick.game_time − fallback_deadline_min and ignored a double-down in an earlier game; after the noon lineups swapped primary and double-down, the deadline became 14:15 − 35 min = 13:40, after the double-down's 13:37 game

code.symbol: run_day (in-loop fallback and post-loop final fallback)

mitigated.action: operator hotfix 6fd61f9 pushed and deployed (run 24311942484) before the 13:37 cutoff

watchdog.trigger: at any check, the planned fallback/delivery time for the current candidate is later than the earliest first pitch minus 5 minutes among its legs
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the planned delivery time precedes the earliest leg's cutoff and the pick is delivered by then

evidence.what: 'Reproduced live on 2026-04-12': after the noon lineups flipped primary (14:15 game) and double-down (13:37 game), the scheduler computed the fallback as 14:15 − 35 min = 13:40 ET, three minutes after the 13:37 first pitch and the BTS submission cutoff
the pick delivered that day (a 16:10 primary with the 14:15 double-down) was locked from the 13:19 ET cascade and posted by the 13:40 ET fallback
head 6fd61f9, created 2026-04-12T17:10:03Z (13:10 ET), concluded success; log expired
both fallback sites derive the deadline from daily.pick.game_time only

notes: disposition changed from the lead row (OI, A): no pick was delivered after its cutoff; the control that held was the operator's live review plus a hotfix deploy, not an automated control — if the lead counts the live post-cutoff deadline itself as the contract deviation, this becomes observed_incident (tier B)
the 13:19 check picked a different primary (16:10) with the 14:15 double-down, so the 13:40 deadline was correct for the pick actually delivered (ev2, I-025)
